greek.note: BANA Nemeth 2022 (test/corpus/sources/Nemeth_2022.txt lines 3023-3048), Greek Alphabet (Standard). Keyed by the Braille-ASCII letter the Code assigns to each Greek letter; the value is [lowercase, capital]. Three letters of the table are absent because the Code writes them with a cell that is not an English letter -- eta ':' (U+2831), theta '?' (U+2839) and chi '&' (U+282F) -- and none of those cells has a symbol row yet. The capitals are taken from the Greek block throughout: the extracted table prints some of them as their Latin lookalikes (line 3025 shows capital alpha as 'A', while line 3026 shows capital beta as the Greek 'B'), which is a PDF text artifact, not two different alphabets.
